title: Jimmy Durante and the College Inn in New York
summary: Sharkey worked three or four months with Jimmy Durante and Sidney Arodin at the College Inn and made an unissued test record.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: That was 1928. Well I was going to ask, there was a, I looked up in a record book just yesterday and they say there's a rumor that you made some early records even with Jimmy Durante and a group that would have had to have been in New York. They were just probably guessing at it. But do you remember, did you ever make any? Yes. In the early 20s. Yes. Did you?

Yes, we made some records with Jimmy Durante. In fact, I worked with Jimmy Durante, oh I think it was about, I'd say about three or four months in a place called the College Inn on 125th Street. Oh really up there?
Yeah. Do you remember when that was?
It was in, I think it was 25. I'm not positive. And they had Sidney Arden. Yeah. And Johnny Stein.
Yeah, I was going to say the drummer was up there. He worked with Jimmy Durante a long time.

They say the record, they made it, somebody had a test record for Victor but it was never issued. No it was not. It was written up in an English book there. I just wondered, I'd never heard about it. It was never released. And this is Johnny Stein, he was the record of the drummer I guess, Jimmy for a long time. Quite a while. Do you remember, that was about 1925 you were in New York.
Well I think once I heard a rumor you played with the Wolverines for a while or something too, was that in New York?
